text: For the front wheel, the spindle bolt is tightened firmly on the left side. The fork clamp bolt is tightened to a torque of 25 Nm on the left side. Watch out: Use utmost caution when you reassemble the front wheel, and make sure it is fitted correctly before you ride. A wheel fitted incorrectly can cause poor performance, an accident, injury to you or other road users, or loss of life. The manual does not give a torque value for the front wheel spindle.
